'''''Integrity''''' was a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruiser]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].

Under the command of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]], ''Integrity'' was attached to [[Home Fleet Strike Group Five/Legends|Home Fleet Strike Group Five]], part of Coruscant's defenses in the latter stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], ''Integrity'' was essential in setting the trap that led to the destruction of the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].
